meaning: Independent finite source-derived evidence for pure Query evaluation over explicit supplied rows, not storage or application provider execution.
inputs: Normalize every declared scalar formal and full Entity row before filtering, ordering, limiting or projection, including unused formals, nonprojected fields and excluded rows. Preserve exact UInt64 carriers, required nullable fields, structural named/optional/list/set/sum values and no factory witnesses.
selection: Interpret checked eq/lt/lte/gt/gte, all/any/not directly from source; preserve Entity identity versus Value Object equality, sum tags, list order and duplicate occurrences, canonical sets, UTF-16 String order and false-before-true Bool order. Preserve no-filter semantics and the source decoder rejection of empty logical predicates.
rows: Preserve all occurrences, stable explicit ascending/descending scalar sorting and unsorted source order, filter before limit and exact declared projection order. Deep frozen detached read-model arrays, not Entity construction or invariant execution. No implicit ordering, coercion or reference lookup.
bindings: Check inert frozen callable descriptors against independently reconstructed checked Query/field/source/provider identities, declared read target/inputs/projection/filter/order/limit and exact effect claims. Never use generated output as expected semantic behavior.
effects: Audit every source Query closure and ready emitted closures with separately bound native AST evidence; exact native imports must stay inside the same Query. Reject selected ambient identifiers, dynamic imports, Object mutation APIs and direct prototype freezing. Retain all source nodes despite finite capacity; observation substitution, script/module drift and late changes cannot authorize or retain native evidence.
bounds: 4096 cases/fact expansions, 4096 row occurrences per case, depth 64 and 8 MiB serialized node cases; test finite limit boundaries only when the limit plus one fits, otherwise retain the whole node as not_evaluable. Shared project: 65536 cases and 8 MiB. Native output/descriptor walks: 65536 visits/depth 64; AST: 1000000 visits/depth 512. Bounded differential/syntactic evidence, not universal proof or arbitrary Proxy/modified-intrinsic purity.
compatibility: Preserve all 53 predecessor sources, previous semantic/effect checks, source schemas, generators, defaults and the full R08-R18 completion denominator. No SFOL, AlchLang, dependency installation, production provider effects, admission or publication.
